about.desc: An index-based asset manager: it reads your folders and never moves the originals. Find images, tag them, build mood boards and drag them into your design apps, all in one window.
about.featSnapshot: Snapshots: keep the batch you picked
about.featBoard: Mood board: an infinite collage canvas
about.stillEarly.title: It's still early — just right.
about.stillEarly.p1: I don't want to turn this software into a business, so there are no ads, no paid memberships, and no pop-ups nagging you to upgrade.
about.stillEarly.p2: I'm only looking for a small group of people who are willing to believe in it once, while so few have used it yet. I call them the "original shareholders" — not because of shares, but because they were earlier than everyone else.
about.stillEarly.p3: Every penny you sponsor stays here, turning into the next line of code, the next member of the software family.
about.stillEarly.disclaimer: "Original shareholder" is only a name. It carries no equity, ownership, dividends or decision-making rights. This project is open source under GPL-3.0, and the code belongs to everyone who follows that licence. I keep my authorship, and I keep my promise that it stays open source.
